description:
Here are the descriptions of the line plots, following your guidelines:

The plots illustrate the relationship between Cost and Stability Score for different model ensembles. Both plots share a common x-axis labeled "Cost" with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 8, with tick labels at intervals of 2. The y-axis is labeled "Stability Score" with a linear scale ranging from 30 to 70, with tick labels at intervals of 10. 

The first plot displays a blue line with circular markers. Starting at a Stability Score of approximately 62 when Cost is 0, the line decreases to a Stability Score of approximately 52 when Cost is 8. An orange line with circular markers begins at a Stability Score of approximately 58 when Cost is 0, and declines to a Stability Score of approximately 32 when Cost is 8. A red line with circular markers starts at a Stability Score of approximately 54 when Cost is 0, and increases to a Stability Score of approximately 56 when Cost is 8.
